question: What cosmic power arises from continually contemplating a smoke-colored form?
premises: A smoke-colored object is to be contemplated always
The triple world is named as the object affected
The power to shake it is stated as a result
inference: By always contemplating a smoke-colored form, one may shake the triple world.
uncertainties: The exact object of contemplation implied by dhūmra-varṇaṃ is not explicitly stated
plain_english: O beloved, by always contemplating a smoke-colored form, one can shake the triple world.
